summary: Adagene Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing that Ms. Chunfang (Vicky) Gu resigned as Executive Director of Finance for personal reasons, effective September 30, 2026. No successor, transition plan, interim appointment, severance, advisor, or board recommendation was disclosed, and Ms. Gu confirmed no disagreement with the board and no matters requiring board or shareholder attention. The filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer current report (US equivalent: Form 8-K Item 5.02 officer departure). Watch for follow-up disclosure naming a replacement or interim finance lead before the effective date.
